prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the supplied gray fuzz circuit diagram image. Keep this existing diagram; make a restrained, faithful edit.
Remove the entire gray screen/paper background, border and all surrounding ragged white/gray speckles. Make every blank area genuinely transparent, including the spaces between circuit lines, around letters and inside open shapes. Retain only the original black labels, black text, and blue schematic lines, symbols and annotations.
Preserve the original circuit layout, relative positions, geometry, components, all black labels and blue notes exactly as shown. Do not redesign, rewire, add, remove or relabel circuit elements. Do not rewrite or fix the strange existing tiny annotations. Keep their current wording. Preserve existing quirks and overall photographed character.
Only subtly improve legibility: slightly strengthen very faint blue lines and tiny text edges and very mildly reduce screen texture. Keep the same black and blue colors. No aggressive sharpening, boldening, modern typography, new diagram, new notes, white panel, background fill, gradient, shadows, glow or decorative effects.
The result must be the original diagram ink floating on a completely transparent PNG canvas, not a gray rectangle on transparency. Clean antialiased line and letter edges, zero isolated background specks. Tight transparent margins around the complete diagram, with all labels retained.
